Does not affect layout; composited on the GPU
sides.code:
transform: translate(10px, 20px) rotate(10deg) scale(1.1);

font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
width: min(100%, 60ch);

margin: calc(var(--gap) * 2);

sides.code:
@layer reset, base, components;

sides.text: Nested grids align to the parent's tracks
sides.code:
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: subgrid;

clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
mask-image: linear-gradient(black, transparent);

sides.text: Never remove focus outlines without a replacement; respect prefers-reduced-motion
sides.code:
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid; outline-offset: 2px; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }
